node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension to the exact datum produced in node 1.3.1. Its literal output u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R is an extended D_2*t_2-isomorphism with the stated near-unit estimate. The uniform u_2 clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, for the same producer output and the same W,D_*, records u_2 as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism with ||u_2(I_{M_{|U|+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= D_*t_2. By def-extended-delta-inclusion this includes both extended D_*t_2-inclusion typing and bijectivity, exactly the typed-reset input required; no inference from bare bijectivity is made.
